title: Signed Temporal Residual Calibration for Closed-Loop Low-Bit Control
hook: Closed-loop PTQ usually scores each quantized call independently or collapses a trajectory into nonnegative motion magnitude. We instead measure the signed finite-horizon accumulation produced by a complete joint bit map and test whether its temporal coherence, rather than residual energy alone, determines downstream drift.
hook_shape_rationale: This is a mechanism-first hook: the named load-bearing variable is the signed accumulation excess over an energy-matched phase-shuffled control, with QuantWAMs and DA-PTQ as the concrete baseline axes where the candidate must be ≤. A pure assumption-pivot hook was viable, but it would make the paper sound like a generic critique of local PTQ; the paired conditional-map mechanism is the deliverable.

gap_closure.gap: 在固定 quantizer、controller 与 deployment budget 下，是否存在跨控制时刻可重复的 residual persistence、sign correlation 或 cancellation，使后续 state/action drift 比 instantaneous residual energy 更可预测，现有 leaves 尚未把这些 temporal modes 与 held-out outcome 分离出来 — stakes: 机器人部署者可能为不导致长期漂移的瞬时误差浪费高精度，而研究者会把 aggregate trajectory correlation 误读成可迁移的量化机制。
gap_closure.how_closed: C04 decomposes a complete quantized rollout residual into signed coherent accumulation and residual-energy components; the companion C02 constructs same-state paired simulator branches and phase-shuffles only the residual order, yielding a controlled downstream separation. Corpus support is thin for this exact WM/WAM quantization setting, so the C04/C02 structural recipe rather than a domain exemplar is the basis of the method.

core_mechanism: The method operates first on the existing DINO-WM Wall checkpoint and planner, with W4/W8 symmetric per-output-channel weight-only RTN and FP32 activations; WAM/VLA transfer is a separate future setting. Let G be the registered eligible Linear block groups and let q assign b_g in {4,8} to every group, so q is a complete joint map rather than a sum of single-site scores; q0 is the all-W4 map. For each calibration snapshot x from a predeclared mixture D_mix = omega D_FP + (1-omega)D_q0 of FP16 and all-W4 reachable states, restore simulator state, controller history, RNG and cache, then run FP16 and q branches to obtain action residual r_t(q)=a_t^q-a_t^FP and cloned closed-loop state features d_l(q)=W_phi[phi(s^q_{t+l})-phi(s^FP_{t+l})] for l in [0,H_ctrl-1]. The action residual is centered and whitened as r°=S_a^{-1}(r-mu_r), with mu_r and S_a fixed from CAL; the state feature phi is the existing DINO-WM Wall state/goal-coordinate vector and W_phi is fixed diagonal whitening from FP16 CAL variance. Define signed accumulation A(q)=E[||sum_l gamma^l d_l(q)||_2^2] and energy E(q)=E[sum_l gamma^(2l)||d_l(q)||_2^2], so opposite signed deviations can cancel in A while the total magnitude remains visible in E. Construct an energy-matched phase-shuffle control by permuting the residual vectors r° within each task and control-time bin, reconstructing the injected action residual with the same S_a and mu_r, and running the same cloned simulator/controller; let A_pi(q) be the median over P_shuffle permutations of the same signed state accumulation. The load-bearing temporal variable is Delta_coh(q)=A(q)-A_pi(q), and the calibration objective is J_STR C(q)=A(q)+lambda_coh max(0,Delta_coh(q)); gamma, H_ctrl, omega, epsilon_phi, epsilon_a, lambda_coh and P_shuffle are named in the implementation manifest and swept before test. Starting at q0, upgrade one eligible group g from W4 to W8 at a time, recompute the whole joint map's J_STR C(q^g), and select the positive conditional reduction per measured logical-byte cost while respecting B_bytes; no single-site scores are added and no map is selected from TEST outcomes. A phase-shuffle intervention, raw residual-energy baseline, and FP16 positive control determine whether the observed conditional gains come from temporal organization rather than generic error magnitude.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1 — observation-model: the DINO-WM Wall simulator exposes replayable state, target coordinates, controller history and RNG; the old verified runner already checks target/seed/state consistency, but the new snapshot fields must be revalidated before measurement.
P2 — The FP/Q action residual sequence is observable at the same restored input because both model checkpoints are available; its sampling is conditional on D_mix and may be selection-biased toward FP or all-W4 occupancy, so omega is predeclared and both strata are reported separately.
P3 — The cloned simulator is deterministic enough under a fixed snapshot and common random numbers that an injected residual branch can isolate the downstream consequence of residual order; this is an untested — falsification target premise, checked by the no-op residual branch.
P4 — Residual temporal organization can add predictive information beyond energy; this is an untested — falsification target premise, tested by Delta_coh and residual phase shuffle.
P5 — A conditional group swap measured on the current complete map is a more faithful allocation primitive than summing FP-background single-group effects; this is an untested — falsification target premise, tested by re-evaluating each accepted swap under the current joint map.
ESTIMAND — J_STR C(q; D_mix, H_ctrl, gamma, lambda_coh) is the expected finite-horizon, whitened signed state-drift objective for a complete joint bit map q over the predeclared FP/all-W4 snapshot mixture, plus the positive coherent excess over its energy-matched residual-order null. Delta_coh(q) is a controlled temporal association, not a causal transfer kernel; causal interpretation is restricted to the same-state residual-injection comparison.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: The naive version is to collect FP16 states, rank groups by layer reconstruction or aggregate motion error, and greedily upgrade the highest-ranked groups once. That version silently assumes the FP16 calibration distribution and nonnegative per-step magnitude are sufficient observations of deployed quantized control; this is false when q changes later states and signed residuals cancel or reinforce across control steps. STRC confronts that failure by sampling both FP and all-W4 occupancy, using same-state residual injection, preserving residual energy under phase shuffle, and recomputing conditional gains on the current joint map.
BLOCK 3 — The anchor is one mechanism with two chained operations: C04 supplies the temporal-mode decomposition and conditional-map treatment, while C02 supplies the controlled null and downstream test needed to distinguish it from magnitude-only allocation. I considered an inference-time observer or delta-action accumulator, but Feedback World Model already owns the general transition-residual observer and that addition would make the result an application of generic feedback control. I also considered a standalone state-distribution reweighting scheme, but QuantWAMs and Calibrate Where You Deploy already occupy that axis; state-mixture sampling remains a controlled input to the temporal objective rather than the claimed contribution. The design explicitly avoids the lineage's static sensitivity node, DA-PTQ's virtual-Jacobian motion node, and the prior RankCal/OTC single-site or one-step mechanisms.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Freeze the primary artifact and quantizer: use the existing DINO-WM Wall epoch-65 checkpoint and verified Wall planner, FP32 reference, W4/W8 symmetric per-output-channel weight-only RTN, and FP32 activations; register the eligible Linear block groups G and the logical/native cost fields. Output: immutable manifest and q0 all-W4 map.
2. Freeze named parameters before inspecting TEST: H_ctrl=5 control transitions per residual window, with a sensitivity sweep {3,5,8}; gamma=0.9 discount, swept over {0.7,0.9,1.0}; omega=0.5 FP/all-W4 state-mixture weight, swept over {0.25,0.5,0.75}; epsilon_phi=1e-3 whitening floor, swept over {5e-4,1e-3,1e-2}; lambda_coh=1, swept over {0.5,1,2}; and P_shuffle=5 permutations, increased to 8 only in the predeclared robustness check. Output: locked parameter file.
3. Create CAL, DEV and TEST splits from the existing Wall target index with episode-level units, using N_cal=8, N_dev=8 and N_test=24 as a bounded pilot scale; use at least N_fit=3 independent calibration fit seeds and keep task/episode identities and CEM seeds disjoint by split. Output: split manifest and paired initial-state list.
4. Collect D_FP and D_q0 snapshots: run FP16 and q0 closed loop with common initial state, controller history, RNG and cache restoration, saving observations, exposed state/goal coordinates, action chunks, and branch checks. Output: replayable FP and all-W4 snapshot records; failed restoration rows are excluded with a recorded reason.
5. At each CAL snapshot, run FP16 and the current complete map q, compute the action residual r_t and the q-versus-FP state-feature sequence over H_ctrl, then estimate mu_r, S_a and W_phi from CAL only. Output: centered/whitened residual and state-drift records plus frozen scaling statistics.
6. Run the same-state residual-order null: permute centered/whitened residual vectors within task and control-time bins using P_shuffle seeds, inject the reconstructed residual into the FP action path, and run the cloned simulator/controller for H_ctrl; keep the state snapshot, controller, and residual-energy multiset fixed. Output: A(q), E(q), A_pi(q), and Delta_coh(q) per snapshot.
7. Starting from q0, enumerate every eligible group g that can be upgraded to W8 within B_bytes, form q^g, and rerun the complete paired rollout and null calculation; compute conditional reduction gain_g=[J_STR C(q)-J_STR C(q^g)]/max(c_g,epsilon_cost), where c_g is measured logical packed-byte increase in fake-quant mode and epsilon_cost is a named positive cost floor selected from the smallest nonzero group cost. Output: one conditional gain table per current map, never an additive single-site ranking.
8. Greedily accept the highest positive gain that keeps q within B_bytes, recompute all remaining conditional swaps after every accepted upgrade, and stop when no gain exceeds tau_gain=0 under the predeclared numerical tolerance; ties use registered group-ID order. Output: one frozen STRC map per CAL fit seed and its byte/latency ledger.
9. On DEV, compare the frozen maps with FP32, all-W4, LocalMSE, DA-PTQ-style motion score, QuantWAMs-style reachable-state schedule and static on-policy recalibration controls; hold seeds, controller, B_bytes and logical budget fixed, and report A, E, Delta_coh, phase-shuffle downstream drift, and action/control metrics. Output: DEV direction/stability report, not a final claim.
10. On TEST, run the same frozen maps on independent episodes and report paired closed-loop success/progress, signed state drift, action error, P50/P95 latency, peak memory and power when a real backend is available. If only fake quant is available, report logical bytes and numerical behavior while marking native bytes/latency as unavailable. Output: bounded held-out falsification result.
falsification_prediction: The minimal pilot is the existing DINO-WM Wall epoch-65 closed-loop setup with the frozen W4/W8 RTN quantizer, CAL/DEV/TEST splits, replayable FP/all-W4 snapshots, and the conditional joint-map procedure above; measure held-out signed state drift, task success/progress, action error and the temporal variable Delta_coh. If STRC works, a map selected by conditional reduction in J_STR C will lower TEST signed accumulated state drift and improve or preserve paired closed-loop success relative to LocalMSE, DA-PTQ-style motion allocation, QuantWAMs-style schedule repair and static on-policy recalibration at the same logical bytes; no numeric outcome bar is asserted. The load-bearing variable is Delta_coh(q)=A(q)-A_pi(q), where A_pi is the median signed accumulation after energy-matched residual phase shuffle. As a negative-control intervention, phase-shuffle the residual sequence while preserving its centered/whitened residual multiset, task/time bin, state snapshot and residual energy; the mechanism predicts the STRC map's downstream drift/success advantage will disappear or move toward the strongest static baseline, whereas the FP16 positive control retains the best numerical drift. If shuffled and real residual order produce the same downstream metric, or conditional-map direction is unstable across the N_fit calibration seeds, the temporal mechanism is rejected; this control tests the task metric rather than merely forcing Delta_coh to zero.
compute_budget: Planning estimate for the bounded pilot: 2-6 A100-80GB GPU-days (up to 4 concurrent single-A100 jobs) for snapshot collection, conditional joint swaps, DEV and TEST; an A100-40GB branch is a separate 1-4 GPU-day feasibility allowance after memory smoke checks. A native low-bit backend, if unavailable, is out of scope for this estimate; fake-quant numerical costs do not imply native bytes or latency. No paid API calls are required ($0 API), and this estimate is not a measured result or a promise of success; expand only if the pilot passes the phase-shuffle and fit-seed stop rules.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: QuantWAMs repairs a fixed denoising-step schedule from a one-call local discrepancy on replayed reachable states; STRC constructs a multi-control-transition signed state accumulation, an energy-matched residual-order null, and conditional joint W4-to-W8 map gains that are recomputed after each swap.

DA-PTQ ranks layers with a virtual planar Jacobian and motion-driven gradient surrogate; STRC measures actual paired FP/Q closed-loop state responses with de-meaned, whitened residual order and tests temporal coherence through a phase intervention.

Feedback World Model maintains a general online latent observer that updates inference state from real transition residuals; STRC leaves the backbone and inference state unchanged and uses quantization-specific residual-order evidence only to select a fixed joint PTQ map.

MARR feeds reconstruction error back into module-specific residual-reconstruction strengths for LLMs and ViTs; STRC's feedback signal is a controlled multi-step simulator outcome and its allocation unit is a jointly reevaluated mixed-bit map.

what_step_was_missed: The closest paper would have needed to construct an energy-matched residual-order intervention that preserves per-window quantization-error content while destroying lag alignment, run it through the same closed-loop transition sequence, and use the resulting signed accumulation excess as a conditional objective for recomputed joint bit-map swaps; its one-call TopK schedule audit does not construct this temporal null or allocation primitive.
